# Garden Safety System

## 1\. Problem Statement

Gardens can be damaged when people or animals enter without permission. A simple automatic system is needed to detect movement near the garden entrance and protect the garden.

## 2\. Proposed Solution

Use an ultrasonic distance sensor to detect an approaching person or animal. When an object comes within a preset distance, the Arduino UNO receives the signal and controls the SG90 servo motor to close a small garden gate.

## 3\. Components

* Arduino UNO  
* HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor  
* SG90 Servo Motor  
* Jumper wires  
* Breadboard  
* Power supply

## 4\. Working

       Person /  Animal  
              ↓  
       Ultrasonic Sensor  
              ↓  
         Arduino UNO  
              ↓  
          SG90 Servo  
              ↓

##        🚪 Garden Gate

Normal condition:  
No object nearby → Gate remains open.  
Object detected:  
Object comes within the set distance → Arduino detects it → SG90 rotates → Gate closes.  
If you set the detection distance to 30 cm:  
Distance \> 30 cm  
       ↓  
   Gate OPEN

## Coding

\#include \<Servo.h\>

Servo myServo;

const int trigPin \= 9;  
const int echoPin \= 10;  
const int servoPin \= 6;

long duration;  
int distance;

void setup()  
{  
  myServo.attach(servoPin);

  pinMode(trigPin, OUTPUT);  
  pinMode(echoPin, INPUT);

  myServo.write(0);

  Serial.begin(9600);  
}

void loop()  
{  
  // Send ultrasonic pulse  
  digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);  
  delayMicroseconds(2);

  digitalWrite(trigPin, HIGH);  
  delayMicroseconds(10);

  digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

  // Receive echo  
  duration \= pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH);

  // Calculate distance  
  distance \= duration \* 0.034 / 2;

  Serial.print("Distance: ");  
  Serial.print(distance);  
  Serial.println(" cm");

  // Object detected within 15 cm  
  if (distance \<= 15 && distance \> 0\)  
  {  
    myServo.write(90);  
    delay(2000);  
  }  
  else  
  {  
    myServo.write(0);  
  }

  delay(100);  
}

The Garden Safety System automatically detects approaching objects and closes the gate using an ultrasonic sensor, Arduino UNO, and servo motor. It helps protect the garden and reduces manual work.
